{"consolidated_memory":"## Route shadowing issues in api/gateway/router.go

The same area of api/gateway/router.go has experienced two separate route shadowing incidents with different root causes:

### Incident 1: [2026-05-31] – N+1 query behind lazy relation
- **File**: api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- **Affected users**: Those in negative UTC offsets
- **Repro**: curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- **Root cause**: N+1 query hidden behind a lazy relation
- **Signal**: Wrong handler name in the request span
- **Fix**: Prefetched the relation in a single query
- **PR**: #5294 on branch fix/route-shadowing-1
- **Result**: Throughput rose 31%, reaching 792 requests per second
- **Context**: Same corner of the file as earlier route shadowing work; context carried over

### Incident 2: [2026-08-02] – Serialiser dropping unknown fields
- **File**: api/gateway/router.go (api gateway side)
- **Affected jobs**: Those scheduled across the midnight boundary
- **Repro**: curl the two overlapping prefixes in order
- **Root cause**: Serialiser dropping fields it did not know
- **Signal**: Wrong handler name in the request span
- **Fix**: Switched to a strict schema that rejects unknown fields
- **PR**: #8283 on branch fix/route-shadowing-2
- **Result**: p99 latency fell from 6.1 s to 300 ms
- **Stack**: Go
- **Test coverage**: api/gateway/router_test.go

Both incidents manifest as route shadowing with identical repro steps and signal, but have entirely different underlying causes and required separate fixes."}
